purpose: Pre-existing receipt-truth violations, surfaced on 2026-07-28 when validator coverage widened from 32 of 128 receipts to all of them. Listed here so they stay visible without red-lighting builder:preflight. New violations are never baselined - they fail. This file is meant to shrink to empty.
rule: Adding an entry here is a deliberate, reviewable act that admits known debt. It is not a way to pass a check. Removing the underlying violation and then deleting the entry is the only correct resolution.

known_violations.why_not_fixed_now: This is the SO-002 Layer A gate receipt asserting PASS with no commit_sha and no production_base, so there is no evidence identifying which build passed. The correct fix is to re-run npm run sentry:site-builder:layer-a and let it stamp a real commit and base. Fabricating a SHA to clear the check would be the exact dishonesty this validator exists to catch.
known_violations.proposed_solution: Re-run the Layer A gate so it writes commit_sha + production_base, then delete this entry.

known_violations.why_not_fixed_now: Asserts a passing walkthrough with no commit or environment recorded, so the claim cannot be tied to a build. The original run cannot be reconstructed after the fact.
known_violations.proposed_solution: Re-run the walkthrough capturing commit_sha + production_base, or downgrade the verdict to UNSOLVED, then delete this entry.
